name: yahboom-mcp
description: SOTA 2026 Yahboom Raspbot v2 ROS 2 MCP Server — motion, sensors, LIDAR, voice, camera PTZ, display, lightstrip, audio, diagnostics, agentic missions, and ROS 2 management for the Yahboom Raspbot v2 robot.

tools.name: yahboom_tool
tools.description: Unified portmanteau for 30+ Yahboom hardware operations: motion (forward, backward, turn, strafe, stop), sensors (IMU, battery, encoders, LIDAR), voice (say, play, play_beep), camera PTZ (up, down, left, right, reset, set_pos), display (write, clear), lightstrip (set RGB, off, light_effect, patrol_car), audio (play, store, play_stored, list_stored, delete_stored, stop, sound), trajectory (start/stop recording, list), diagnostics (health_check, config_show, inspect_stack, execute_command), and safety (stop_all).

tools.name: yahboom_demo
tools.description: Boomy show-floor demos: floor chalk art drawing (smiley, heart, boomy_b patterns) and social talkbot with approach, PTZ wiggle, TTS speech.

tools.name: yahboom_agentic_workflow
tools.description: High-level robot goal planning via MCP sampling (SEP-1577). Plans and executes sequences of operations: get_robot_health, move_robot, read_sensors.

tools.name: yahboom_agent_mission
tools.description: LLM mission planner: natural-language goal to structured JSON plan with optional ROS publish and TTS speech feedback.

tools.name: yahboom_help_tool
tools.description: Multi-level help system with drill-down by category (motion, sensors, connection, api, mcp_tools, startup, troubleshooting) and topic.

tools.name: ros_topic_list
tools.description: List all active ROS 2 topics and their message types for full sensor/control stack visibility.

tools.name: ros_node_info
tools.description: Get detailed info about a specific ROS 2 node: publishers, subscribers, services via SSH.

tools.name: ros_resync
tools.description: Force re-discovery of all ROS 2 topics and re-subscribe to sensors.

tools.name: ros_restart_bringup
tools.description: Remotely restart Yahboom bringup nodes via SSH — nuclear option for unresponsive robot.

tools.name: lidar
tools.description: LIDAR and map data from Yahboom /scan (per-sector obstacle distances) or Dreame D20 Pro floorplan maps.

tools.name: audio
tools.description: Play/store/manage audio files through USB voice module speaker: play MP3/WAV, built-in sound effects, store/play_stored/list_stored/delete_stored/stop.

prompts.name: yahboom_quick_start
prompts.description: Step-by-step instructions to connect and run the Yahboom Raspbot v2.

prompts.name: yahboom_patrol
prompts.description: Generate a patrol plan (square or figure-8) for a given duration.

prompts.name: yahboom_diagnostics
prompts.description: Diagnostic checklist for the Yahboom robot and MCP server.

prompts.name: yahboom_patrol_apartment
prompts.description: Standard action: patrol the apartment (full circuit, avoid obstacles).

prompts.name: yahboom_go_to_recharge
prompts.description: Standard action: drive to charging station and stop.

skills.name: yahboom_quick_pilot
skills.description: Quick pilot skill for immediate robot control.

skills.name: yahboom_patrol_sweep
skills.description: Patrol sweep skill for autonomous area coverage.

skills.name: yahboom_emergency_halt
skills.description: Emergency halt skill for immediate robot stop.

skills.name: yahboom_diagnostic_triage
skills.description: Diagnostic triage skill for robot health checks.
